verdict.rationale: Jev is a model API, so tool calling is a fair question to ask of it. But the evidence only documents typed decision questions (Choice, Score, Noul) answered in batched calls to POST /v1/systemone. Nothing documents tool or function definitions, the model emitting tool calls, or parallel or multi-step tool-call loops. Using a Choice question to pick an action, or the coding-agent skill, is at best an adjacent developer building block, not faithful tool calling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on faithful function/tool calling — typed tool definitions, parallel and multi-step calls — documented well enough to run an agent loop on this model
